6) Number formatting decisions
- Original uses space as thousands separator and comma as decimal (e.g., "1 100,00"). Per rules: keep number of decimal places identical. Do not invent currency markers. For final extraction must convert to numeric types while preserving decimals (e.g., 1100.00) — ensure two decimals as in input.
